info.title: humanOS API
info.description: Backend API for humanOS: nutrition, workouts, health metrics, goals and recommendations.

post.description:
Creates the account, sends the email verification link and issues the first
personal access token. The token is named after `device_name`, or the User-Agent
when it is missing.

Checks the credentials and issues a new personal access token. Wrong credentials
return a validation error on `email`. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per email and IP.

Emails a password reset link. The response is the same whether the email is
registered or not, so it cannot be used to discover accounts.

message.const: If that email is registered, a password reset link has been sent.

post.description:
Sets a new password using the token from the reset email, and revokes every
personal access token of the user.

get.description:
Marks the email as verified. This is the link sent by email: it is authenticated by
its signature (`expires` and `signature` query parameters), not by a token. Verifying
an already verified email succeeds.

post.description: Revokes the token used for this request. Other tokens of the user stay valid.

get.description: Returns the user the bearer token belongs to.

post.description:
Sends a new verification link to the current user. Returns 202 when the email is
sent, and 200 when the email is already verified.

get.description: Lists the user's personal access tokens, newest first. Token values are never returned.

delete.description: Deletes every token of the user, including the one used for this request.

Deletes one of the user's tokens. A token that does not exist or belongs to another
user returns 404.

get.description:
Returns every ingredient whose English name or English alias contains `search`, ignoring case and
accents, in one unpaginated list: the catalog plus the caller's own ingredients, never another
user's. A user's ingredient matches on its name only. Ranked by the name: an exact match first, then
names starting with the term, then names with a word starting with it, then the rest (mid-word or
alias-only matches); ties sort by name, then key. The caller's own ingredients get no priority and are
marked by `is_mine`. Values are per 100 g. `nutrients` and `source` are only returned by the detail
endpoint. Each ingredient's first photo is its main photo; use its `thumbnail_url` in lists.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matched anywhere in the English name or an English alias, ignoring case and accents.

get.description:
Returns one ingredient by its key, with every measured nutrient per 100 g and the data source. A
nutrient that wasn't measured is left out; clients show it as "no data". Another user's ingredient
is a 404. A user's ingredient has no nutrients or photos yet, and its source is `user` with a `null` id.

patch.description:
Changes only the fields sent; `fiber: null` clears the fiber. The sum rule is checked with stored
values filling the fields not sent. `portions`, when sent, is the full new list: items with a `key`
update that portion, items without one are new portions, and portions left out are removed. Only the
owner may edit: a catalog ingredient is a 403, another user's is a 404. Returns the detail shape.

delete.description:
Deletes the caller's own ingredient and its portions. It's gone from every endpoint afterwards. Only
the owner may delete: a catalog ingredient is a 403, another user's is a 404.

get.description:
Returns the caller's own ingredients, paginated and sorted by name, then key. Items have the search
shape: `nutrients` and `source` are only returned by the detail endpoint.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
Returns the user's body profile with their latest weight and target weight. Values are
returned in the user's `unit_system` and in metric. A user who has not saved a profile
yet gets 404.

put.description:
Creates the user's profile or fully replaces it; every field is required. Values are read
in `unit_system` units, stored in metric, and `unit_system` is kept as the display
preference. Each save also records one weight entry and one target weight entry, even when
the values did not change. Always returns 200.

get.description:
Lists every weight the user has recorded, newest first. One entry is added on each profile
save. `weight` is in the profile's `unit_system` (metric if the user has no profile yet).

Lists every target weight the user has set, newest first. One entry is added on each profile
save. `target_weight` is in the profile's `unit_system` (metric if the user has no profile yet).

Lists the body areas in display order, each with its muscles in display order. Clients use
it to draw the body map and to label the muscle keys that exercises return.

Lists the equipment groups in display order, each with its equipment in display order.
Clients use it to draw the equipment tabs and to label the equipment keys that exercises
return.

Returns the exercise catalog, paginated and sorted by name, or ranked by the muscle when
`muscle` is set. Filters combine with AND, and values inside one array filter combine with
OR. `location` keeps only the exercises saved at one of the caller's workout locations and combines with
the other filters, the muscle ranking included. `instructions` and `source_id` are only returned by the
detail endpoint.

parameters.name: equipment_group[]
parameters.description: Only exercises whose equipment is in one of these groups. Keys come from `/equipment-groups`.

parameters.name: equipment[]
parameters.description: Only exercises with one of these pieces of equipment. Keys come from `/equipment-groups`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match anywhere in the name.

parameters.name: muscle
parameters.description: Only exercises tagged with this muscle, primary or secondary. Primaries come first, ranked by the muscle's position and then by fewest primaries; secondaries follow, sorted by name. Keys come from `/muscle-areas`.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only exercises where `muscle` has this role. Needs `muscle`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Only the exercises saved at this workout location. Must be the key of one of the caller's locations, from `/locations`.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
Returns one exercise by its key, with its photos and instructions. Muscles and equipment are
keys: clients get their labels from `/muscle-areas` and `/equipment-groups`.

Returns the caller's workout locations, sorted by name, then key, with how many exercises each has. Not
paginated: a user has at most 20. The exercise keys are only returned by the detail endpoint.

post.description:
Creates a named location for the caller, with no exercises yet. The location gets a generated `l_` key
that never changes. A user has at most 20 locations, and names are unique per user, ignoring case and
accents. Returns the detail shape.

get.description:
Returns one of the caller's locations with the keys of its exercises, sorted by exercise name, then key.
Clients use them to mark exercises already at the location. Another user's location is a 404.

patch.description:
Changes only the fields sent; an empty body changes nothing. Keeping the current name is allowed, and
taking another of the caller's location names, in any case, is a 422. Another user's location is a 404.
Returns the detail shape.

delete.description:
Deletes one of the caller's locations and its exercise list. The exercises themselves are not touched.
Another user's location is a 404.

put.description:
Saves the exercise at one of the caller's locations. Idempotent: an exercise already there is also a 204,
so a double tap or a retry is safe. The location's `updated_at` only moves when the exercise was added.
Another user's location, or an unknown exercise, is a 404.
put.summary: Add an exercise to a workout location

delete.description:
Removes the exercise from one of the caller's locations. Idempotent: an exercise that isn't there is also
a 204. The location's `updated_at` only moves when the exercise was removed. Another user's location, or
an unknown exercise, is a 404.
delete.summary: Remove an exercise from a workout location

equipment.description: The equipment in the group, in display order.

key.description: Stable identifier, used by exercises to reference the equipment.

author.description: Photo author, only set for wger photos. Clients must show it when set.

credit_url.description: Link to the photo's source, only set for wger photos. Clients must show it when set.

key.description: Stable identifier, used in the URL.

examples: Shoulder blades pinned back, bar to mid-chest.

equipment.description: Equipment key. The label comes from `/equipment-groups`.

equipment_group.description: Equipment group key. The label comes from `/equipment-groups`.

primary.description: Keys of the muscles doing most of the work, most direct first. Every exercise has at least one. A muscle appears in `primary` or `secondary`, never both, and muscles that only stabilise are in neither. For example, the chest does the pressing in a barbell bench press, so `lower_chest` and `upper_chest` are primary. The labels come from `/muscle-areas`.

secondary.description: Keys of the muscles that assist the primary ones, in order. Can be empty: stretching and foam-rolling exercises have none. For example, the front delts and triceps help the chest in a barbell bench press, so `front_delts`, `triceps_lateral` and `triceps_long` are secondary. The labels come from `/muscle-areas`.

instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions. Only returned by the detail endpoint.
examples: Lie back on a flat bench.
Lower the bar to your chest.

source_id.description: The free-exercise-db id. Only returned by the detail endpoint.

IngredientCategory.description: How a person shops for the food. The frontend's 13 keys (`app/types/food.ts`).
IngredientCategory.title: IngredientCategory

amount.description: Amount per 100 g, in `unit`. A measured `0` is sent as `0`.

url.description: The photo at the detail-view width. Use it as given; never build photo URLs.

thumbnail_url.description: The photo at the list and card width. Use it as given; never build photo URLs.

license.description: License short name. Clients must show it wherever they show the photo, linked to `license_url` when set.

license_url.description: Link to the license. `null` only for some `CC0` and `Public domain` photos.

author.description: Credit for the photo. Clients must show it when set. `null` for `CC0` and `Public domain` photos.

credit_url.description: The photo's source page. Clients must link to it wherever they show the photo.

key.description: Stable identifier of the portion within its ingredient.

grams.description: Weight of the portion in grams.

key.description:
Stable identifier, used in the URL. Catalog keys are snake_case words; a user's ingredient has a
generated `u_` key.

name.description: English name for catalog ingredients. A user's ingredient returns its name as written, in any language.

is_mine.description: Whether the caller owns the ingredient: `true` for their own, `false` for catalog ingredients.

per_100g.description:
Energy and macronutrients per 100 g: `kcal` in kcal, the rest in grams. `fiber` is `null` when it
isn't known; clients show it as "no data" and leave it out of totals.

portions.description: Portions in display order. Can be empty.

photos.description:
Photos in display order. The first is the main photo, for lists and thumbnails. Can be empty. Clients must
show each photo's `author`, license and a link to `credit_url` wherever they show it.

nutrients.description: Measured nutrients per 100 g, in display order. Unmeasured ones are left out. Only returned by the detail endpoint.

source.description:
Where the values come from: the USDA FoodData Central dataset and the FDC id, or `user` with a `null`
id for a user's ingredient. Only returned by the detail endpoint.

IngredientSource.description: Where an ingredient's values come from: a USDA FoodData Central dataset (SPEC 15), or the user who typed them in (SPEC 18). Catalog entries never use `user`.
IngredientSource.title: IngredientSource

muscles.description: The muscles in the area, in display order.

key.description: Stable identifier, used by exercises to reference the muscle.

body_view.description: The body map view the muscle is drawn on.

height.description: Height in `unit_system` units: centimetres (metric) or inches (imperial).

weight.description: Latest weight in `unit_system` units: kilograms (metric) or pounds (imperial).

target_weight.description: Latest target weight in `unit_system` units: kilograms (metric) or pounds (imperial).

StoreIngredientRequest.description: A new private ingredient, typed in from a food label (SPEC 18). Strings are trimmed by the global middleware.

name.description: 1–100 characters after trimming, in any language. Not unique.

kcal.description:
Energy per 100 g, in kcal. Not checked against the macros: labels round, and alcohol or sugar
alcohols add calories the macros don't explain.

fat.description: Grams per 100 g. `protein + carbs + fat` may be at most 100.

fiber.description: Grams per 100 g. Leave it out or send `null` when the label doesn't list it. Not in the sum rule.

portions.description: Measures in display order, at most 10. Keys are generated.

grams.description: Weight of the measure in grams: more than 0, at most 5000.

StoreIngredientRequest.title: StoreIngredientRequest

StoreWorkoutLocationRequest.description: A new workout location for the caller (SPEC 19). Strings are trimmed by the global middleware.

name.description: 1–50 characters after trimming. Unique among the caller's locations, ignoring case and accents.

StoreWorkoutLocationRequest.title: StoreWorkoutLocationRequest

target_weight.description:
Target weight in the profile's `unit_system`: kilograms (metric, also used when the user
has no profile) or pounds (imperial).

UpdateIngredientRequest.description:
A partial edit of the caller's own ingredient (SPEC 18). A field that isn't sent keeps its stored value.
Authorization runs before validation, so a catalog ingredient is a 403 whatever the body.

name.description: 1–100 characters after trimming, in any language. Not unique.

fat.description: Grams per 100 g. `protein + carbs + fat`, with stored values filling the fields not sent, may be at most 100.

portions.description:
The full new list of portions, in display order, at most 10. Leave it out to keep the portions as they
are. An item with a `key` updates that portion, an item without one is a new portion, and a portion
left out is removed. `[]` removes them all.

key.description: A current portion of this ingredient, at most once. Leave it out for a new portion.

grams.description: Weight of the measure in grams: more than 0, at most 5000.

UpdateIngredientRequest.title: UpdateIngredientRequest

unit_system.description:
Units of `height`, `weight` and `target_weight`: cm/kg (metric) or inches/lb
(imperial). Also saved as the user's display preference.

birth_date.description: The user must be 13 to 120 years old today.

height.description: Height in centimetres (50–272) or total inches (19.7–107.1).

weight.description: Current weight in kilograms (20–500) or pounds (44.1–1102.3), at most 1 decimal.

target_weight.description: Target weight in kilograms (20–500) or pounds (44.1–1102.3), at most 1 decimal.

UpdateWorkoutLocationRequest.description: A partial edit of the caller's own workout location (SPEC 19). A field that isn't sent keeps its stored value.

name.description:
1–50 characters after trimming. Unique among the caller's other locations, ignoring case and accents.
Keeping the current name is allowed.

UpdateWorkoutLocationRequest.title: UpdateWorkoutLocationRequest

weight.description:
Weight in the profile's `unit_system`: kilograms (metric, also used when the user
has no profile) or pounds (imperial).

key.description: Stable identifier, used in the URL and in the exercise list's `location` filter. Never changes.

exercise_count.description: How many exercises are saved at the location.

exercises.description:
Keys of the exercises saved at the location, sorted by exercise name, then key. Only returned by the
detail shape (create, show and update). Full exercise cards come from `/exercises?location=<key>`.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
